purpose: Translate user-defined venom composition into evidence-guided hypothetical snake concepts.

controls.label: Three-finger toxins
controls.definition: The source category for the three-finger toxin protein family.
controls.boundaries: Includes functionally diverse members. Do not equate this family with alpha-neurotoxins or cytotoxins alone.
controls.interpretation: Retrieve subtype-specific evidence before describing a particular mechanism.
refinements: Source-defined molecular subclasses with separate quantitative measurements; functional tags are not automatically disjoint subtypes.
controls.design_role: Select documented reference profiles containing this family. Reference anatomy remains an illustrative choice, not a consequence established by the percentage.

controls.label: Phospholipases A2
controls.definition: The source phospholipase A2 family category.
controls.boundaries: Do not equate total PLA2 with a neurotoxic subtype or enzymatic activity; activity and functional effects vary among members.
controls.interpretation: Retrieve subtype and assay context before assigning functional characteristics.
refinements: Catalytic status and molecular identity, only if explicitly measured; do not infer partitions from effect names.
controls.design_role: Introduce relevant measured reference profiles without forcing a taipan, aquatic anatomy, or a fixed body shape.

controls.label: Venom metalloproteinases
controls.definition: The source snake venom metalloproteinase family category.
controls.boundaries: P-I, P-II and P-III classes and disintegrin-containing proteins require source-specific accounting. Never add a parent total to its subcomponents.
controls.interpretation: Use assay-supported protein-cleavage or vascular findings with their experimental context.
refinements: P-I, P-II and P-III, when the original source reports mutually exclusive class abundances.
controls.design_role: Permit diverse reference anatomies; SVMP-containing reference profiles include both vipers and boomslang. No stocky-body or triangular-head rule is established.

controls.label: Venom serine proteases
controls.definition: The source snake venom serine protease family category.
controls.boundaries: A family total does not identify a particular coagulation target or establish the net clotting effect of a mixture.
controls.interpretation: Require relevant functional evidence for coagulation claims.
refinements: Identified proteases with documented measurements and functional targets.
controls.design_role: Use documented species as references while leaving morphology conditional on separately sourced traits.

controls.label: Kunitz-type proteins
controls.definition: The workbook's KSPI category, named Kunitz-type serine protease inhibitors in the cleaning dictionary.
controls.boundaries: Kunitz-type proteins can differ in function; do not equate all KSPI with dendrotoxins or active protease inhibition.
controls.interpretation: A specific channel or enzyme effect needs molecular evidence.
refinements: Dendrotoxin identity or other identified Kunitz members, with independent abundance evidence.
controls.design_role: Mamba profiles can be illustrative references; a Kunitz percentage does not specify mamba morphology.

controls.label: C-type lectins
controls.definition: The workbook CTL label, retained exactly as a distinct source category.
controls.boundaries: Do not merge with CLP (Snaclec) until the contributing study's definitions and overlap are reviewed.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: C-type lectin-like proteins
controls.boundaries: Distinct from CTL and the separate ambiguous workbook label CLP. Do not sum or alias those labels automatically.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: Cysteine-rich secretory proteins
controls.boundaries: Not a universal ion-channel or muscle-effect measurement.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: L-amino acid oxidases
controls.definition: The source L-amino acid oxidase family category.
controls.boundaries: Abundance alone is not measured oxidative activity or a rate of prey incapacitation.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: Disintegrins
controls.boundaries: Distinguish separately quantified disintegrins from domains counted within SVMPs; resolve conventions per source.
controls.interpretation: A specific adhesion or platelet effect requires identified-component evidence.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: Natriuretic peptides
controls.boundaries: Do not merge NP, C-NP, BNP or BPP solely on naming or related physiology.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

controls.label: Bradykinin-potentiating peptides
controls.boundaries: Separate from natriuretic peptides and ambiguous peptide labels. Label expansion is not functional validation.
controls.interpretation: Functional interpretation requires further primary-source curation.
controls.design_role: Reference context only; no direct physical-trait rule.

accounting.source_only_policy: Preserve all other source labels and unidentified components individually when loading a historical profile. Never drop them or renormalize the selected controls.
accounting.unidentified_policy: No ID is an observation category, not a phenotype-driving control.
accounting.unallocated_policy: Display 100 minus the explicit assigned total as a UI balance only. It is not a measured unidentified component and must not silently become No ID.
accounting.source_mixture_policy: Do not pool studies or measurement types. This control catalog is not evidence that source categories are universally mutually exclusive.

phenotype_policy.change_behavior: A composition edit may change selected references or explanations. It does not require every physical trait to change. Preserve explicitly locked creative choices. No continuous response curve is claimed.
